SELECT * FROM ( SELECT inner_query.*, ROWNUM rnum FROM ( SELECT
p.SCIENTIFIC_NAME AS scientificName, p.COMMON_NAME AS commonName, p.FAMILY AS family, p.GENUS AS genus, p.ORIGIN AS origin, p.DESCRIPTION AS description, p.SAMPLE_IMAGE_URL AS sampleImageUrl, p.COMMON_USES AS commonUses, p.CULTURAL_SIGNIFICANCE AS culturalSignificance, p.ENVIRONMENT AS environment, p.LIGHT AS light, p.TEMPERATURE_HUMIDITY AS temperatureHumidity, p.WATERING AS watering, p.SOIL AS soil, p.FERTILIZER AS fertilizer, p.POT_REPOT AS potRepot, p.PESTS_TIPS AS pestsTips, p.PROPAGATION AS propagation
FROM PLANT_INFO p
SAMPLE_IMAGE_URL IS NOT NULL
AND p.SCIENTIFIC_NAME LIKE '%' || #{filters.scientificName} || '%'
AND p.COMMON_NAME LIKE '%' || #{filters.commonName} || '%'
AND p.FAMILY LIKE '%' || #{filters.family} || '%'
AND p.GENUS LIKE '%' || #{filters.genus} || '%'
AND p.ORIGIN LIKE '%' || #{filters.origin} || '%'
ORDER BY
${sortField} ${sortOrder}
p.SCIENTIFIC_NAME ASC
) inner_query WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{limit} ) WHERE rnum > #{offset}
